EXPLANATORY NOTES ON GUIDELINES ON MEDICAL REPORT FEES

1. QUESTIONNAIRE  
(a) Definition: A form requiring medical information other than demographic data (such as name, age, sex, ID number, occupation, etc.). It should usually not exceed 20 items or 2 pages.  
(b) Clinic Visit Claim Form  
(i) The form is usually completed by the doctor on the same clinic visit or consultation. A key is only disagreeable if the form is presented by the patient on a day other than the clinic visit. It includes administrative work and time. If the form is disagreeable, the recommendation is up to $10.  
(ii) The fees charged include 5 breakdowns of charges:  
- Basic consultation fee (5 items or less) such as name, age, sex, ID number and occupation, etc.  
- Special Report for Court Attendance  
- Specialist Report for Court Attendance  

2. RECOMMENDED FEES FOR MEDICAL REPORT

a. Simple Report: $90 - $120  
- A simple report is a brief medical report usually consisting of one or two pages of history, physical examination, diagnosis, and treatment. It is usually prepared by the doctor who has seen the patient. It usually does not require more than half an hour. As a guide, 95% of simple reports should be completed within 30 minutes.

b. Standard Report: $120 - $240  
- A standard report is a more detailed report (e.g. subjective complaints, more comprehensive physical examination, investigations included, e.g. blood tests, X-rays, ultrasounds, etc.). It usually requires more time and effort.

c. Specialist Medical Report: $240 - 600  
- A specialist medical report is a detailed report involving multiple medical problems, or major surgery, with opinions based on detailed clinical examination, investigations, or imaging (e.g. radiology, histopathology). More than two pages. As a presentation goes (single line spacing).

d. Detailed Medical Report for Litigation or Court Attendance  
- A detailed medical report for litigation or court attendance is a legal document prepared at the request of the solicitors to be given as evidence in a court of law.
